note: Stage order and wiring (pins-addendum F3). Paths in folder, command and checks are relative to the repository root; outputs are relative to the run folder. RUN in a command stands for the run folder. required_outputs lists the run-relative paths or globs a stage must write (each present, readable and newer than the stage start); every check names its owner (the stage whose output it judges; ad.py next reruns that owner when the check fails on a later stage) and its audience (plugin-ci, run-builder-log or run-customer-question).

checks.name: check_architecture
checks.fallback: an architecture check agent reads available detail in stages/architecture/agent.yaml against the check's rules; the canonical graph is optional. Preserve the original check report and write a separate fallback report with check, revision, why and applied per-item verdicts; record unavailable detail as open

checks.name: check_grants
checks.fallback: a grants check agent compares the proposed writes with the upstream Write grants table; preserve the original check report and write a separate fallback report with check, revision, why and applied per-item verdicts

stages.note: route.py runs after the review, carried out in the session, writes stages/review-a/verdict.json

checks.name: check_boundaries
checks.fallback: a boundaries check agent derives the boundaries from the future state and compares them with stages/boundaries/boundaries.json

checks.name: check_rules
checks.fallback: a rules check agent validates every rule in stages/rules/rules.json against the rule format and the declared tokens

checks.name: check_outcomes
checks.fallback: an outcomes check agent looks for gaps and overlaps between the rules and stages/rules/outcomes.json

checks.name: check_placement
checks.fallback: a placement check agent confirms every rule is placed on a future-state step and every stand-in is declared

checks.name: supply_check
checks.fallback: a supply check agent confirms every token a rule reads is supplied by a field or a declaration

checks.name: dropped-families
checks.fallback: a families check agent lists the failure-handling rule families the fields imply and the rules omit

stages.note: after the review, carried out in the session: plan, then apply-known, then the session carries out each stages/review-b/fix/<stage>.md in turn (each fix records itself in stages/review-b/fixes.json), then settle; when settle reports placement_pending (a kept rules fix added rules), carry out stages/review-b/fix/placement.md and run settle (line 3) once more, inside the same round

checks.name: check_cases
checks.fallback: a cases check agent validates stages/test-suite/test-suite.json against the suite and case formats and the rules it covers

checks.name: check_read
checks.fallback: a read check agent compares the dispatched read's verdict with the walk result and the frozen expected values

checks.name: screen_judgments
checks.fallback: a screening agent reads each frozen judgment answer in simulation/sim-input.json for invented values
checks.blocking_note: flags never stop the walk result being shown: a failing screen leaves the stage done and flagged, and the flags go to the register and the page

stages.note: the commands run before the stage prompt is carried out; the read prompt is prompt.md in the folder

checks.name: check_coherence_gate
checks.fallback: a coherence check agent reads stages/coherence-gate/report.json, or runs each stage check by hand when the gate could not run, and lists every failing or unchecked item

checks.name: register
checks.fallback: a register check agent confirms every open item reached stages/register/register.json with its source

stages.note: collect runs before the writer; after the writer the session carries out reader.md from the folder as a separate read, and when the reader reports findings the writer's repair step (the writer applies them, the reader reads once more); then views

checks.name: plain_text
checks.fallback: a plain-language check agent reads stages/page-prep/page-prep.json for banned words, raw ids and jargon

stages.note: no command; finish calls fill_stage(run_dir, "page"), which runs the final gate

checks.name: postrun
checks.fallback: a post-run check agent lists banned words, uncited Observed claims, ids and paths in the run's written files as builder-log notes; it never blocks and never asks

checks.name: check_rules_page
checks.fallback: a rules page check agent compares the rules on agent-design.html with stages/rules/rules.json
